tips.text: Copper turns green over time; honeycomb wax stops it, and an axe scrapes off the wax or one stage of rust
Crouch to avoid falling off ledges
Gold tools mine faster than diamond, enchant well and carry Fortune II or Looting II, but wear fast and mine only what iron can
Beds set your spawn in the Overworld and explode in any other dimension
Endermen are hurt by water, anger when looked at, ignore you behind a carved pumpkin and never pick up blocks
Smelt sand into glass; glass breaks into shards unless mined with Silk Touch, and shards craft back into glass
Shields cut damage from the front, Creeper blasts included, and better shields cut more; an axe hit disables one for 5 seconds
Fortune works on coal, copper, iron, gold, redstone, lapis, diamond, emerald and quartz ores, and on ancient debris
Monsters cannot spawn on lit blocks, or on bottom slabs, glass, carpet or leaves
Sprinting makes you hungrier
Villagers trade for emeralds, and every trade gives them experience toward better trades
Zombies, Skeletons and Phantoms burn in sunlight; a helmet, water or shade saves them, and Husks never burn
Creepers run from cats and Ocelots, and Phantoms keep away from cats
Land in water, powder snow, cobwebs or on a slime block to take no fall damage; hay bales and honey blocks cut it by 80%
Pigs breed with carrots, potatoes, beetroot or golden carrots, and have litters of 2 to 3 piglets
Shear sheep for wool: a killed sheep drops none
Milk removes all potion effects
Looting increases mob drops
Animals that die on fire drop cooked meat, whether from Fire Aspect, Flame or lava
Blazes are weak to snowballs
Soul sand slows you down unless your boots have Soul Speed, which makes you faster on soul sand and soul soil
Scaffolding can be climbed, reaches 6 blocks out from a support, and breaks all at once from the bottom
Composters turn plants, food, straw, bark and sawdust into bone meal
Barrels cost less than chests and open with a block on top, but cannot join into a double chest
Smokers cook food and blast furnaces smelt ores and raw metal twice as fast as a furnace, but take only their own kind
Anvils rename items cheaply and repair or combine them; costs rise with each use but never become 'Too Expensive'
Grindstones remove every enchantment except curses and give back some XP
A lectern holds a book anyone can read and sends a redstone pulse on each page turn
A stonecutter turns one block into stairs, walls or two slabs with no waste
Hoppers pull items from above, push into the container they face and stop while powered
Comparators detect container fullness, compare, and subtract redstone signals!
Axolotls play dead to heal, and killing a mob one is fighting gives you Regeneration
Bees fill hives with honey; take it with a bottle, or honeycomb with shears, and keep a campfire below to calm them
Spyglasses, made from amethyst and copper, zoom in on distant things
Goats can ram you off cliffs, and a Goat that rams a hard block drops a goat horn
Frogs eat small Slimes for slimeballs and small Magma Cubes for froglight in the Frog's colour, set by its biome
Use a water bottle on dirt to make mud; mud above pointed dripstone dries into clay
Mangrove trees grow in water
Sugar cane grows on sand or dirt
Pumpkins and melons need a free dirt, grass or farmland block beside the stem to grow
Campfires place unlit and cook four items; rain puts one out unless a coal or charcoal block is under it
Ring a bell, by hand or with an arrow, to send villagers indoors and make nearby raiders glow
Mending repairs held and worn gear with the XP orbs you collect, before the XP reaches your level
Unbreaking III makes gear last longer
Silk Touch collects beehives with bees inside
Feather Falling cuts fall damage and stops you trampling farmland
Thorns damage enemies who hit you
Underwater, Respiration and turtle shells add breath, Aqua Affinity restores mining speed and Depth Strider speeds you up
A thrown ender pearl teleports you where it lands, costs a little health and sometimes spawns an Endermite
Chorus fruit teleports you randomly
Golden foods give Regeneration and Absorption; gilded foods give more of both plus Resistance and Fire Resistance
Potions of Speed make you run faster
Potions of Strength increase melee damage
Potions of Haste speed up mining
Potions of Night Vision let you see in the dark
Potions of Fire Resistance stop lava damage
Potions of Water Breathing let you breathe underwater
Lingering potions create effect clouds
Splash potions affect multiple entities
Spectral arrows highlight enemies
Cure a Zombie Villager with a splash Potion of Weakness, then a golden apple
Cartography tables zoom out, copy and lock maps; a cauldron of water wipes one clean
Looms put patterns on banners; banner pattern items unlock the rare ones
Fireballs can be hit back at Ghasts
Magma blocks hurt anything on them unless it crouches or wears Frost Walker boots
Ice melts near bright light, but packed and blue ice never do
Blue ice is the slipperiest block to walk on; boats get no extra speed on any ice
Lava flows further in the Nether
Water cannot be placed in the Nether, except in a cauldron
A sponge soaks up to 256 water blocks; dry a wet one in a furnace or by placing it in the Nether
A conduit in a prismarine frame gives Conduit Power underwater, and a full frame makes it attack hostile mobs
A beacon's pyramid size unlocks effects, a richer base block strengthens them, payment sets the range, glass colours the beam
Elytra let you glide from a height; repair them with phantom membrane
Fireworks boost elytra flight; a campfire below lifts you and a soul campfire pulls you down
Shulker boxes keep their items when broken; craft them from shulker shells, dropped by Shulkers in End Cities
End crystals respawn the Ender Dragon
Silverfish come from spawners and from infested blocks, which look like stone but break fast
Wandering Traders offer exotic items
Leads let you walk animals and tie them to fences
Name tags prevent mobs from despawning
Saddle a horse, pig or lava-walking Strider to ride it; steer pigs with a carrot on a stick, Striders with a warped fungus on one
Horse armor protects your mount
Llamas can carry chests for storage
Mules are a cross between horses and donkeys
Blocking a Ravager's bite with a shield stuns it, and it roars to knock you back when it recovers
Vindicators are fast and dangerous
Some Pillager outposts hold caged Allays
Villagers take the job of a free workstation nearby and keep it once you have traded with them
Snow Golems leave snow trails and throw snowballs; shear off the pumpkin to see their face
Suspicious stew gives one effect, set by the flower it was made with
Lava buckets are a great furnace fuel
Wooden buttons and pressure plates react to arrows and items, stone ones only to players and mobs
Iron doors and iron trapdoors open only with redstone
An open trapdoor above a ladder can be climbed like one
Stairs, slabs, fences, walls, panes and many other partial blocks can hold water
Fences connect to solid blocks and are too high to jump, and fence gates in them open either way
Pointed dripstone fills cauldrons
Powder snow freezes anyone who sinks into it; leather boots let you walk on top
Magma cubes are immune to fire
Piglin Brutes never barter
Hoglins breed with crimson fungus and flee warped fungus, portals and respawn anchors; out of the Nether they become Zoglins
Bastions hold gold blocks and rich loot, Pigstep disc included
Compasses point to spawn in the Overworld, to your entry portal in the Nether and to the exit portal in the End
Daylight detectors give a signal in sunlight, or at night once clicked to invert them
Cactus blocks destroy items
Sand, gravel and concrete powder fall with nothing below; a falling anvil or pointed dripstone hurts what it hits
Concrete powder hardens into concrete when it touches water
Item frames go on any face, floors and ceilings included; a glass item frame hides its frame
Honey bottles remove poison
Feed baby horses sugar, wheat, apples or hay to make them grow faster
Raw fish heals injured cats
Zombies break wooden doors on Hard difficulty
Skeleton horses spawn during storms
Slimes spawn in swamps at night and in certain chunks below y 40
Witches use potions to heal
Big dripleaves collapse under weight
Glow berries provide light and food
Sculk catalysts spread sculk where mobs die nearby
Soul torches give less light than torches but do not melt snow or ice
Nether gold ore and gilded blackstone drop gold nuggets
Twisting vines grow up and weeping vines grow down; both can be climbed
Lava flowing over soul soil next to blue ice turns into basalt
Water and lava make cobblestone, or other stones when the lava touches certain blocks
Obsidian forms when water hits source lava
Obsidian and crying obsidian cannot be pushed by pistons
Strongholds have libraries full of books
Eyes of Ender lead to the portal
Shulkers fire levitation bullets
Every player can take an elytra from each End ship
Armor stands have arms and can hold an item in each hand
Pistons push up to 12 blocks; sticky pistons also pull one back, even another piston
Redstone torches invert signals
TNT is lit by flint and steel, fire charges, fire, redstone or Flame arrows
The recovery compass, crafted with echo shards, points to where you last died
Swift Sneak, found only in Ancient City chests, lets you walk faster while crouching
The blind Warden, summoned by sculk shriekers, hunts by sound; sneak to stay quiet and throw items to lure it away
Wool and carpet hide vibrations from sculk, steps on them included, and a minecart over wool runs silently
Allays fetch items matching the one you give them, and one dancing to a jukebox duplicates when given an amethyst shard
Glow ink sacs from Glow Squids make sign text glow and craft glowing wool and carpet; an ink sac clears sign glow
Firework rockets with stars deal blast damage when fired from crossbows
Multishot fires three arrows and Piercing goes through mobs, but not both; Quick Charge reloads faster
Sweeping Edge increases the damage of your sword's sweep attack
Knockback is great for keeping Creepers at a distance
Smite hits undead harder, Bane of Arthropods hits spiders harder and cuts cobwebs fast; neither combines with Sharpness
Impaling tridents deal extra damage to all aquatic mobs
Tridents: Loyalty returns them, Channeling calls lightning, Riptide launches you in rain, water or a cauldron but excludes both
On bows, Power adds damage, Punch knockback, Flame fire, and Infinity spares arrows; Infinity and Mending exclude each other
Tipped arrows can apply potion effects from a distance
Observers detect block updates in front of them
Target blocks give a stronger redstone signal if hit in the center
Note blocks play different sounds depending on the block below
Trapped chests give off a redstone signal when opened
Redstone repeaters can delay signals up to 0.4 seconds
Droppers move items, while dispensers use them
Dispensers can equip armor onto players and armor stands
Powered rails speed carts up slopes, detector rails signal when a cart passes and activator rails eject riders
Redstone dust can travel up transparent blocks like glass
Slime blocks bounce you, honey blocks stop jumps and let you slide down walls, and the two never stick together
Sweet berry bushes slow you down and hurt you unless you wear leggings
Foxes pick up and use dropped items, so a Fox holding a Fire Aspect sword can set you alight
Polar Bears are peaceful unless you get near their cubs
Pandas have personalities set by their genes, and a sneezing baby Panda can drop slimeballs
Parrots imitate nearby hostile mobs, and cookies poison them
Hero of the Village, good gossip and curing a Zombie Villager lower prices; a cure's discount is lost if it turns again
Iron Golems guard villages and drop no iron when killed; heal one with iron ingots
Vindicators named 'Johnny' will attack every nearby mob
A totem of undying saves you from your hand or your charm slot
Vexes are summoned by Evokers and can fly through walls
Phantoms spawn after three nights without sleep; wind chimes keep them away
Slow Falling potions are made using phantom membranes
Drowned mobs can spawn with tridents and nautilus shells
Scutes are dropped when baby Turtles grow into adults
Dolphins will lead you to shipwrecks if you feed them fish
Underwater, soul sand makes bubble columns that push up and magma blocks make ones that pull down
Kelp can be smelted into dried kelp for a quick snack
Sea pickles provide light when placed underwater
Coral fans must stay in water or they will turn gray
Fish, axolotls and tadpoles can be carried in water buckets
Pufferfish deal poison damage if you touch them
Lush Caves are filled with moss, glow berries, and spore blossoms
Pointed dripstone can be used to create infinite lava or water
Azalea trees mark the location of a Lush Cave below
Lightning rods protect your wooden roofs from fire
Tinted glass blocks light but is still transparent
Budding amethyst in underground geodes grows clusters that drop four shards; it cannot be moved, even with Silk Touch
Deepslate is tougher than stone and takes longer to mine
End crystal beams can be blocked with blocks to stop the Dragon's heal
The dragon breath can be collected in glass bottles
Lingering potions are made using dragon breath
Wither Skeletons spawn only in Nether Fortresses and sometimes drop their skull
Three Wither Skeleton skulls on a T of soul sand or soul soil summon the Wither, which drops a Nether star
Netherite armor is fireproof and won't burn in lava
Ancient debris is most common around y 15 in the Nether and smelts into netherite scrap
Lodestones allow compasses to point to a specific block
Piglins love gold and will barter with you for it
Wear gold armor to stop Piglins from attacking you
Piglin Brutes protect Bastions and cannot be distracted by gold
Zombified Piglins are neutral until you attack them
Ghast tears are used to brew Regeneration potions
Magma cream is used for Fire Resistance potions
Ruined portals appear in both the Overworld and the Nether
Respawn anchors, made from crying obsidian and charged with glowstone, set your spawn in the Nether and explode elsewhere
Blackstone can be used as a substitute for cobblestone
Basalt Deltas are home to Magma Cubes and ash particles
A coal block smelts 80 items, 8 more than its nine coal; a dried kelp block smelts 20 and bamboo only 0.25
Place lava or water above pointed dripstone to slowly drip it into a cauldron below!
Baby mobs have their own models instead of being shrunken adults
Tame wolves with bones and heal them with any meat, rotten flesh included
Protection, Fire, Blast and Projectile Protection exclude each other; each specific one guards best against its own damage
Frost Walker boots freeze the water under you so you can walk on it
